title: feat(port): slice 133 — i.a(boolean) rescan + S9/S10 stagger arm + al()/H()
body:
## Summary

Ports `i.a(boolean)` — the side-strip rescan called from ~10 live sites (as `probeSnapSides`: `x()` probe, worst-cell `aT`/`aU`, clearance `aX`/`aY`, `bb`/`bc` wall flags, `z2` wall snap + re-probe, `i.t`/`i.u` center as `centerX`/`centerY`) — plus `i.M()` (`floorAhead`), `i.al()` (`ledgeHangGrab`, the wide ledge mount → `i(61)` + `aC=40`), `i.H()` (`dropHeld`), and the live `S9/S10` stagger-recoil arm (`ag/=2` decay, `ab` box tracking, `r()` → `G()`+`H()`+`i(1)`+`a(false)` with the `!M()` fall-through, `Q∈{0,54}` `a(true)` pulse).

Mining caught a real subtlety: the g.java:824-844 case-0 block (edge ledge-grab via `ak()||al()`, down-drop, aF latch, one-way hang) is **provably dead** — e()'s head clears `cp/cq/ct/cu/cv/cw` every tick and `case 0` sets none, so all four checks read false. Documented as omitted-with-citation rather than ported, since activating it would create behavior the original doesn't have.

Gates: verifier `ok:true`, 57 unittests, `:core:test` 917 (+12), `:android:assembleDebug`, `:gdx:build`. Plan: `plans/260922-0520-slice133-stagger-recoil/`.
